value.rationale: The shared-control reset threshold is a motivated invariant of automaton direct products and is not constrained sharply by the general max/sum product bounds. The theorem completely classifies the first nontrivial smaller Černý factor C_3 for all larger n, proves a uniform one-letter latency ceiling and precisely locates the arithmetic zero-overhead cases. This is a structural all-n exact classification, beyond the prior finite n≤11 census and the known divisible baseline, with meaningful implications for synchronizing-language intersection.
